name: code
description: Adds spec tracking folders (.claude/specs/in-progress, .claude/specs/completed) and a code-quality rule that auto-loads on source files.
postInstallMessage: Code module installed. Drop draft specs in .claude/specs/in-progress/ and move them to completed/ when shipped. code-quality.md auto-loads on .py/.js/.ts/.tsx/.go/.rs/.java files.
